name: How Customizing Works
tone: clear, friendly, reassuring, explaining a simple process step by step
facts: the process has 6 steps: pick a personalizable product in the shop, choose a color and motif using the on page customizer, optionally add a name or short phrase in Bengali or English script, add to cart and send the order on WhatsApp with one tap, the studio confirms the final design and price with the customer over WhatsApp, then the piece is handmade to order and shipped
there is no online payment on the website, payment and final confirmation happen after the WhatsApp conversation
not every product is personalizable, only ones marked Personalizable in the shop
personalization is mainly a name or short phrase, plus a choice of color and motif depending on the product
customers unsure what to choose can message the studio directly on WhatsApp for suggestions
